svg.title: Figure 2-1: safety-function cards
svg.desc: Twelve cards in four rows of three, grouped as stops demanded by a person or a device, monitoring that demands a stop, restart, inhibit and warning, and the arm and lift functions of CFG-002; each card has a header coloured by Performance Level with the function's ID and name, a demand column with an arrow to a safe-state column, and badges for category, stop category and response target.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 2-1 The safety functions: demand, safe state and the attributes a safety-requirements specification needs

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One card per function of §2; the header colour is the required Performance Level. Text is the table's, cut with an ellipsis where it does not fit.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
